requirement: Bicycles should be equipped with a bell or equivalent audible warning device. Federal regulation CPSC 1512 does not mandate this, but multiple state/local regulations require it (e.g., New York State Vehicle and Traffic Law §1236-b, Georgia, etc.).
requirement_summary: Bell or audible warning device recommended (required by some states, not federal CPSC 1512)

evidence_required.description: BOM must contain bell or audible warning device component

remediation: Install a bell or equivalent audible warning device if the product is intended for sale in jurisdictions that require it (e.g., New York, Georgia).
